query:
UPDATE business_staffing_rates
                SET is_active = FALSE,
                    superseded_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                    superseded_by_account_id = $5
                WHERE tenant_id = $1
                  AND rate_kind = $2
                  AND customer_id = $3
                  AND employee_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $4
                  AND is_active
                  AND effective_from >= $6
